tasks.title: The drive times the red-first proof and the helper reports each leg's seconds
tasks.description: Design: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-11-27-speed-red-first.md section 2, T2. Around red_reading's run in writer_prove and in submit's red_block, stamp start and measured length and queue_stage a 'proof' stage (source proof:<at>, basis naming the legs: baseline/task/fix seconds from the helper). The helper adds each leg's seconds and a legs list to its payload; a leg not run says so. A refused or blockless proof still queues its length. Acceptance: on a recorded run the window between writer end and gate selection is covered by proof + wait stages. Dependants: red_reading parse, hold_proof, note_reproof. test_drive_phase.py is expensive: run named cases via --stage while iterating.

add: tests/test_drive_phase.py: a writer round's red-first proof queues a proof stage whose length is the measured run

tasks.title: A red-first leg whose exact inputs did not change is reused, not rerun
tasks.description: Design: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-11-27-speed-red-first.md section 2, T3. Keep each leg's result under the exact inputs it read (HEAD sha, argv, leg name, files laid over by path+sha256, stubs, absent, inline overlays digest, dependency plan, the helper's own code digest, interpreter version) under the git common dir, newest N, written only when the key read after the leg equals the key before. A hit replays code/text and says 'reused, key K, recorded at T'; the throwaway tree is built only when a leg misses. Dependants: red_verdict, leftover_throwaways (must ignore the store). Red-first case: leaving one key field out (mutation) makes a changed-input case reuse a stale leg and must go red.

tasks.title: A comment-only edit to the task's tests does not rerun the task leg
tasks.description: Design: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-11-27-speed-red-first.md section 2, T4. The task leg runs HEAD's implementation, so only the test files' code decides it: key the task leg (P173.3's store) on a Python token digest without COMMENT/NL tokens (other languages: bytes). tree_since_proof says 'test files changed outside their code (comments only)' so prove_and_hold does not rerun the task leg for it. The stamp lock stays a byte digest; the proof's basis names the code digest. Dependants: lock_moved, changed_tests, note_reproof, file_writer_return's drift check, the stamp's take (must keep reading bytes). Known limit to state in the basis: a test reading its own comments or line numbers.

Run the red-first stage's commands beside the other steps, with the red suites taken out of the remaining steps' path lists (the narrowing base runs already use: _declared_suites_at_base, _joined_at_base).
